parameters.name: AccountName
parameters.description: The name of the account whose password you want to reset. > Only the passwords of standard accounts can be reset.

parameters.name: AccountPassword
parameters.description: The account information for the accounts whose passwords you want to reset. Separate multiple account entries with commas (,).

parameters.name: DBInstanceName
parameters.description: The instance ID. > You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~196830~~) operation to query the details of all instances in the specified region, including instance IDs.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. > You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~98041~~) operation to query available regions.

parameters.name: SecurityAccountName
parameters.description: The name of the account whose password you want to reset. > Only the passwords of standard accounts can be reset. You can invoke the [DescribeAccountList](~~196844~~) operation to query the account information of the target instance, including account names.

parameters.name: SecurityAccountPassword
parameters.description: The password of the security administrator account. > This parameter is required if the three-role mode is enabled. For more information about the three-role mode, see [Three-role mode](~~213824~~).
